steps.text: Identify how far CG is out of range2.
steps.text_clean: Identify how far CG is out of range.

notes.text: This is often a given value to use (e.g., ACFT weight 2,500 LBS).

A range will be given for CG and the current CG location (e.g., 64"-70"; CG @ 71.2"). Subtract the desired location from the current location (e.g., 71.2" - 70" = 1.2"), this is how far out of range the CG is. When shifting CG, shift it to the closest limit it currently is out of.
This location is usually a baggage compartment or a given fuselage station (e.g., ballast location +45").
Plug the values into the formula for the needed ballast weight. Using the previous example calculations: (2,500 x 1.2) / (70-45) = 3,000 / 25 = 120 LBS.
